Third-party code shipped with EMCON (unmodified):

- jsQR.js: jsQR 1.4.0 (https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR), Apache License 2.0, see LICENSE-jsQR. Reads QR codes from camera frames and images.
- qrcode.js: qrcode-generator 1.4.4 (https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator), MIT License, (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase. Draws QR codes.
